title: Co-op aiming (joseau11's, off by default): target markers, keep / switch / share targets (DPC 0.9.172-dev6)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party, open ground, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Player 2 ideally on an archer or mage pawn (any works). Three tough goblins will be spawned (they cannot die). About 3 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.aim: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.cfg.coop_aim == true
probes.dbg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.ta_dbg or '')
probes.p2t: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.coop.tgt_name or 'none')
probes.p2a: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.coop.tgt; local ok, a = pcall(function() return t and t:get_address() end); return ok and a or 0
probes.pin: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.pin ~= nil
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1 ~= nil
probes.p1set: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1_set == true
probes.same: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local a, b = D and D.R.ta.p1, D and D.coop.tgt; if not (a and b) then return false end; local ok, r = pcall(function() return a:get_address() == b:get_address() end); return ok and r
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen, player 2 a pawn). 20 seconds.
Three tough goblins in front. Do nothing yet: player 2 should get an automatic target with a coloured marker above it. 8 seconds.
PLAYER 2: tap R3 (right stick click) once: 'target kept', the marker gets a ring. 8 seconds.
PLAYER 2: flick the right stick RIGHT, wait a second, flick it LEFT, a few times: the kept target moves to the next goblin on that side. 12 seconds.
PLAYER 2: tap R3 again: back to the automatic target (the ring goes). 6 seconds.
PLAYER 1: point the camera at a goblin and click R3 (right stick): player 1's marker (another colour) appears on it and the Arisen locks on. 8 seconds.

expect.label: the Arisen's lock-on took player 1's target

steps.text: PLAYER 2: HOLD R3 for a second: player 2 takes player 1's target (two markers side by side). 8 seconds.
Both fight 20 seconds. Do attacks and skills go to your own targets? Player 2 tries another flick and R3 tap mid-fight.
PLAYER 1: click R3 again on the same goblin: player 1's target released. 6 seconds.
Removing the goblins. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. 12 seconds.
Done (co-op aiming switched back off). Tell Claude: were the markers clear? Did keep / flick / share feel right? Should it be on by default?
